description: Registar obnovljivih izvora energije i kogeneracije te povlaštenih proizvođača is a dataset listed in NIPP Geoportal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Državna geodetska uprava. The RES & CHP Register is a unique record of renewable energy and high-efficiency cogeneration projects, production plants using renewable energy sources, i.e. high-efficiency cogeneration plants and eligible producers in the territory of the Republic of Croatia. The RESCR has been set up by the ministry responsible for energy. Coverage: HR. The portal shows the English title as "Register of renewable energy sources and cogeneration and eligible producers" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspiregeoportal, Registar OIEKPP, Proizvodna i industrijska postrojenja, proizvodnja električne energije, obnovljivi izvori energije, OIE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nipp.
